room_rent.note: If room taken exceeds limit, all other hospital expenses (except medicines) are reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment on every admissible claim

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; modern treatments at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern/advanced treatments (robotic, HIFU, etc.): up to 50% of SI

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, varicose veins, ENT disorders, etc.; 36 months for joint replacement, osteoporosis

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed limit of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (Annexure A, List I)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, sterility/infertility, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, obesity surgery (conditional), gender change, cosmetic surgery
plan_name: Arogya Sanjeevani Policy, Bajaj General Insurance
